_comment: The registry of every Brandklout Instatic plugin: its source folder, the version that is RELEASED
(the only version anyone may install), the permissions we grant it, and which sites must carry it.
`version` must equal the folder's plugin.json version; every command in plugins.mjs refuses to run
when they disagree, so a bump is always two edits in the same commit (step 01 of scenario 4).
Hosts are NOT here: production and staging come from ../instatic-domain-origins/sites.json
(`<client>` and `<client>-staging`), credentials from the matching ~/.webzite/.env section.
`grants` is the security review, written down. install-plugin.mjs grants exactly this list and
refuses a package that asks for anything else. Widen it only on purpose, with the reason in `why`.

why.cms.hooks: the publish.html filter that rewrites the page CSP meta tag and adds siteScripts
why.modules.register: the Embed block in the canvas module library
why.frontend.assets: module render() js: the auto-height listener served from /_instatic/module-js/brandklout.embed-origins.embed.js

changelog.1.5.1: 2026-09-10: id renamed webzite.embed-origins -> brandklout.embed-origins (byte-identical to 1.4.0 otherwise).

why.cms.hooks: publish.html filter writing og:/twitter: tags, the canonical link, the meta description and the favicon links
why.cms.storage: per-page overrides in the plugin's own record table
why.cms.routes: the admin page and bulk API under /admin/api/cms/plugins/<id>/runtime/, all behind a session
why.cms.content.read: read-only pages + posts + articles, to publish the seoDescription the platform stores and never emits
why.admin.navigation: the Open Graph item in the admin sidebar
why.editor.code: required by the host for an adminPages app page; one hand-written file

changelog.1.2.0: 2026-09-25 mason-park: favicon + appleTouchIcon settings; writes <link rel=icon> and apple-touch-icon unless the page already names one (the platform has no favicon setting).

changelog.1.1.2: 2026-08-28 dr-nahlah: the version every other site ran on 2026-09-10.
